name: Computer-use agent inference provider
one_line: An OpenAI-compatible, hosted-or-BYOC endpoint for screenshot-heavy computer-use agents: an open VLM at a screenshot-sized visual-token budget (322 tokens per 1280x800 frame vs 1,105 on GPT-4o), exact-frame dedup, session-affinity prefix warmth and per-request savings telemetry, with the ~40x headline shown to be modeled, the 7.3x redundancy prize bounded at ~2.3x, no OSWorld/WebArena validation yet, and a backend that is stock vLLM flags.

unproven.claim: Task success holds at the 322-token (native 1280x800, 1.05 MP cap) screenshot budget on real CUA tasks
unproven.experiment: Run OSWorld-Verified and/or a 100-200-task WebArena subset with the same model at native vs capped resolution, 5 seeds; report success and p50 step latency; the accuracy point that exists (0.925 DocVQA) is at 1,017 tokens on documents, not screenshots
unproven.cost_estimate: ~40 GPU-hours (A100 at Modal $2.50/h, ~$100) plus API spend for the Sonnet 5 arm; ~5 calendar days

unproven.claim: Cost per completed task beats hosted Qwen3-VL-8B at $0.20/MTok and Anthropic Sonnet 5 at equal or better success
unproven.experiment: Same run as above with five backends (vanilla vLLM default flags, SGLang, hosted Qwen3-VL-8B, Sonnet 5 with computer-use toolset and documented caching, Browser Use bu-30b-a3b on vLLM); bill from vLLM usage fields; publish $/task

unproven.claim: The exact-duplicate frame cache fires on a material share of real agent steps (it requires identical frame bytes and identical concatenated text)
unproven.experiment: Replay recorded OSWorld / Browser Use trajectories through the gateway and count served_from_cache; compare against examples/agent_loop.py's fabricated 1-in-3 duplicate rate

unproven.claim: Session affinity raises the prefix-cache hit rate on CUA prompts (images in history) across multiple replicas
unproven.experiment: Deploy >= 4 vLLM replicas behind a consistent-hash router keyed on x-dexa-session; measure usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens and TTFT with and without affinity; the measured 12x/25-34x prefix-cache TTFT win is on a text model, single replica

unproven.claim: Steps per GPU-hour at the CUA budget support a price below hosted Qwen and the frontier providers
unproven.experiment: Load test with the voice-inference harness pattern (N-slot loadgen, p95 step-latency gate) on A100 and H100; the only throughput point today is 30.2 document pages/s at 1,017 tokens on one A100

unproven.claim: Delta-perception reuse of unchanged-region vision embeddings at cos >= 0.98 preserves grounding accuracy (ceiling 2.34x)
unproven.experiment: Grounding eval (ScreenSpot-style click accuracy) with reused vs fresh embeddings; requires an mRoPE-aware forward pass since masked pruning breaks Qwen2.5-VL get_rope_index

unproven.experiment: Run dexa_platform/docker-compose.byoc.yml on a rented A100/H100 box and drive it with examples/agent_loop.py; the compose has never been executed in-repo

unproven.claim: CUA turn, idle-gap and concurrency distributions (needed for affinity and pinning design)

founder_decisions.options: Qwen2.5-VL-7B (deployed; 0.925 DocVQA at 1024px) | Qwen3-VL-8B (DocVQA 96.1 per its report, Apache-2.0, vLLM/SGLang) | Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B | a CUA-trained model such as Browser Use's bu-30b-a3b | train a specialized grounding model Morph-style
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Model choice sets cost, accuracy and defensibility at once; no CUA-suite number exists in the research files for any of these models, so the Week 1 task-success run per model is the evidence, and the trade-off between an off-the-shelf open model and a trained one is a strategic bet on the team's capabilities

founder_decisions.decision: Hosted vs BYOC vs open-source gateway
founder_decisions.options: Hosted endpoint (Modal-backed) | BYOC recipe plus telemetry license | open-source gateway with paid hosted tier | all three
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Determines what is sold and to whom; BYOC removes the data-residency objection but leaves telemetry as the only paid artifact; pilot conversion in Week 6 is the evidence, and the operating-model choice is the founder's

founder_decisions.options: A100 ($1.39-2.79/h across providers) | H100 ($1.73-12.29/h) | L40S ($0.99-1.95/h) | MI300X ($2.59-6.00/h) | spot/preemptible variants
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Steps per GPU-hour at the CUA budget is unmeasured on every class; the Week 4 throughput run per class is the evidence; capex/opex posture is a founder call

founder_decisions.decision: Whether frontier and open-host adjacency matters
founder_decisions.options: Proceed regardless | proceed only if the benchmark shows >= 3x cost advantage vs Sonnet 5 and a measurable advantage vs hosted Qwen | do not proceed
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Gemini 3 offers a 280-token low-res image mode, DeepSeek bills images at up to 384 tokens at $0.44/MTok, Anthropic ships the toolset and caching guidance, Morph lists Glance, and any Qwen host bills the same 322 tokens for a 1280x800 frame; these are stated as facts, and the founder asked that 'X already exists' judgments be left to them

founder_decisions.decision: Whether to fund the delta-perception R&D
founder_decisions.options: Fund the mRoPE-aware reuse engine targeting the measured ~2.3x ceiling | treat ~2x as sufficient for a pricing edge and ship the gateway-only product | drop the perception thesis and compete on price/telemetry alone
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: The ceiling (2.34x at cos >= 0.98, never near 7x) is measured, but whether a 2x execution-owned lever justifies 2-3 engineer-weeks plus ~60 GPU-hours against a blocked architecture is a capital-allocation judgment

founder_decisions.options: Per step (per screenshot) flat price | per token at a blended open-VLM rate (~$0.20/MTok assumed) | $0 cached steps and discounted prefix hits (needs the affinity router) | BYOC license; publish the baseline price table or let buyers set it via x-dexa-baseline
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: The architecture makes per-step pricing expressible, but no $/step cost exists until the Week 4 throughput measurement; margin and positioning are founder choices

founder_decisions.decision: Benchmark suite and definition of proof
founder_decisions.options: OSWorld-Verified | WebArena | Browser Use's Odysseys | a customer-supplied task set; 1, 3 or 5 seeds; success-rate tolerance (3 pts proposed)
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: The pre-registered thresholds in the brief are proposals, not measurements; which suite buyers trust and how many seeds count as proof determine the credibility of the Morph-style 'proven value' claim

founder_decisions.decision: Whether the 'cheaper-VLM reseller' wedge is acceptable
founder_decisions.options: Accept the wedge (gateway + budget + telemetry on a stock engine) and compete on DX and BYOC | require an execution-owned differentiator before launch | fold this direction into the stateful-session or document-VLM candidates
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: docs/FINDINGS.md explicitly rejected this framing ('the defensible company isn't a cheaper-VLM reseller'), while the founder's brief asks for niches found through proven value; market size and defensibility judgments are reserved for the founder
